head: 9ee0f8ea27ea2536ab398902cb5b2ea5f92aecdb
conclusion: No actionable source correctness finding in scoped audit. Native/guest/generated-schema qualification remains pending.
coverage: Legacy module JSON default/skip-empty serialization and v2/v3 persistent framing remain intact; catalog wraps with v4.
Factored property encoder tags, lengths, signed-zero and sorted-object bytes match former TS implementation; aggregate budget handling preserved.
Cook embeds scene-bound canonical bytes; runtime depends on types/ABI/sha2 and consumes trusted binary, not authoring or JSON.
Bounds checked before copy, shared call/transfer quotas applied, current-epoch errors poison finish and stale epochs do not poison new authority.
Exact EntityIdentity membership captured at startup, pruned after accepted structural publication and at begin/checkpoint; fresh restore rebinds only saved members under catalog digest.
Both host reload paths prepare a fresh candidate with same catalog before transferring accepted state; checkpoint receiving program binds catalog.
Two-host fixtures cover independent props, unrelated entity, same-ID respawn, checkpoint continuation/mismatch and scratch/stale/callback/trap refusals.
qualification_notes: Actual two-host fixtures and strict lint have not run; source review cannot replace those results.

New tests do not directly exercise catalog-bearing hot reload after owner retirement, nor immediate save on the removal tick. These are useful focused regressions for the new reload/prune seams, not identified source defects.
Raw transfer-quota and negative/out-of-range capacity boundaries rely on shared implementation; new focused tests directly cover short copy and call quota.
Fresh headless generated-schema comparison and ordinary authored source-free player proof are explicitly still pending.
review_helper_correction: Initial data-only ABI comparison assumed registry key imports; actual key is functions. It stopped with KeyError after source hash checks; corrected comparison passed. No product change or native execution.
